description: If two consecutive forward stages are equal, every later stage equals that fixed stage.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.stationary.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.Rule α)) {k : ℕ}
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.stage Γ (k + 1) = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.stage Γ k)
  (m : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.stage Γ (k + m) = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.stage Γ k
